name: screencue
description: Persistent, click-through desktop arrows controlled directly by your assistant.
long_description: ScreenCue draws a large hand-drawn arrow and an independent target outline without taking focus. It follows the target application window locally and keeps a labelled edge cue when the target moves offscreen. Hide a hint with screen_clear or Ctrl+Alt+X (Ctrl+Option+X on macOS). ScreenCue does not capture screenshots, identify controls, click, or type. The assistant needs a separate authorized passive screen observation tool. Adaptive color may sample small local pixel regions while visible; those pixels are never saved or transmitted. No API key, network server, Node.js, or Python runtime is required for this binary extension.

tools.name: screen_hint
tools.description: Draw a persistent click-through hint at observed desktop coordinates.

tools.name: screen_status
tools.description: Inspect the hint and native window tracking state.
